biotools.summary: TFTG is a database providing a comprehensive collection of human transcription factor (TF)-target gene resources, integrating data from ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, motifs, and experimental confirmations. It offers user-friendly search, analysis, browsing, downloading, and visualization functions to facilitate research on TF-target gene regulation.
